verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a test step where you can simulate interactions with its AI support agent before deployment, and you can scope deployment so the agent only touches issues you explicitly assign it. That offers limited pre-production testing of agent behavior. There is no evidence of an actual sandbox environment or workspace isolated from production data for API, MCP or agent testing. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test workspace, isolated test data for API/MCP/webhook calls, documentation of how simulations avoid touching production records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
